title: Fix off-by-one in container hostname ID truncation
body:
## Summary

Fixes an off-by-one error in `libpod/container.go` where container IDs with exactly 11 characters could trigger a slice-out-of-bounds panic.

The previous implementation checked:

```go
if len(c.ID()) < 11 {
    return c.ID()
}

return c.ID()[:12]
```

When the container ID length was exactly 11, the condition evaluated to `false`, causing execution to fall through to `c.ID()[:12]`, which attempts to slice beyond the end of the string and results in a panic.

This patch updates the boundary check from `< 11` to `< 12`, ensuring that IDs shorter than 12 characters are returned as-is and only IDs with at least 12 characters are truncated.

## Changes

- Fix the off-by-one boundary check in `libpod/container.go`.
- Change the condition from `len(c.ID()) < 11` to `len(c.ID()) < 12`.
- Add `TestHostnameShortIDTruncation` in `libpod/container_internal_linux_test.go`.
- Cover the following cases:
  - 11-character container ID (regression test)
  - Exact 12-character container ID
  - IDs shorter than 11 characters

## Result

The hostname generation logic no longer panics for 11-character container IDs, and behavior remains unchanged for all other valid ID lengths.

Signed-off-by: Prayag <rajprayag014@gmail.com>
